title: storage: add recovery from crash
description: Implement crash recovery logic that detects and restores transcript state from persisted storage after unexpected termination. This includes detecting incomplete writes, validating recovered data integrity, and providing a clean recovery workflow for the Progressive Discover system.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL check for existing transcripts on startup
THE SYSTEM SHALL make recovery transparent to the user when possible

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the application starts after an unclean shutdown
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL detect any unsaved or partially saved transcript state and offer recovery options

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a corrupted transcript is detected
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL attempt to recover the most recent valid version or notify the user of data loss

unwanted.condition: IF recovered data is incomplete or corrupted
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT present invalid state to the user
unwanted.because: presenting corrupted data could lead to confusion or further errors

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT automatically choose without user confirmation
unwanted.because: the user should decide which recovery state to restore

preconditions: TranscriptStore must support versioning or snapshots
Application must track dirty state for recovery detection
Recovery checkpoint markers must be written during saves
postconditions: Application can detect previous crash on startup
Recoverable transcripts are identified and offered for restoration
Recovery log is created for debugging purposes
invariants: Recovery never loses data that was successfully persisted
Partial writes are detected and handled appropriately
Recovery state is cleared after successful restoration

happy: Verify recovery detects and restores transcript after simulated crash
Verify recovery handles clean shutdown without prompting
Verify recovered transcript matches pre-crash state
Verify recovery checkpoint is cleared after successful restore
error: Verify recovery handles corrupted checkpoint files gracefully
Verify recovery fails safely when no valid recovery data exists
Verify recovery does not duplicate or lose transcript entries

similar: See recovery patterns in database systems
